title: Piping from transfer pump to equipment or storage tanks above the lowest floor.
officialText: Supply piping from a transfer pump to equipment at levels above the lowest floor or storage tanks at levels above the lowest floor in buildings shall also comply with the requirements of Section 1305.9.
